name: wave1-S09-colour
refs: art/station-masters/pods/source/raw/mibi-juvenile-S09-a.jpg
Our signed young S09, Belatz (project-owned): the creature and its plumage, exactly.
art/station-masters/pods/source/raw/plate-S09-colour.jpg
Our signed Colour plate of the Belatz (cobalt): the framing, brush and light every panel must match.
prompt: Paint TEN panels in a 5 by 2 grid, equal size, small gaps. Every panel is the same close-up of the creature's body plumage (overlapping soft feathers filling the panel), the same framing and the same light, as in the Colour reference. Only the feather colour changes. TOP ROW, left to right: 'cobalt' (deep cobalt blue), 'cobalt and lagoon' (cobalt feathers mixed with lagoon blue-green feathers), 'cobalt and periwinkle' (cobalt mixed with soft periwinkle lavender-blue), 'cobalt and jade' (cobalt mixed with jade green), 'lagoon' (lagoon blue-green). BOTTOM ROW, left to right: 'lagoon and periwinkle', 'lagoon and jade', 'periwinkle' (soft periwinkle lavender-blue), 'periwinkle and jade', 'jade' (jade green). In a two-colour panel the two colours are mixed feather by feather, roughly half and half, never in stripes or halves. Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) between and around the panels, no borders, no text, no numbers. Same brush and soft painterly light from the top left as the references in every panel. No props, no ground, no shadow, no glow.

prompt: Paint SIX panels in a 3 by 2 grid, equal size, small gaps, all in the creature's cobalt plumage. TOP ROW: the same close-up of the creature's back and wing as the Fluff reference, the same pose in each; only the down changes: left 'short, straight' (short straight down lying flat), middle 'between' (as the reference), right 'long, swept' (long soft down swept back in drifts). BOTTOM ROW: the same close-up of the breast feathers as the Sheen reference; only the surface changes: left 'matte' (dry, chalky, no highlight at all), middle 'between' (as the reference), right 'glossy' (a soft satin sheen along each feather, still painterly, never wet, never a glow). Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) between and around the panels, no borders, no text, no numbers. Same brush and soft painterly light from the top left as the references in every panel. No props, no ground, no shadow, no glow.
